title: Visual Page Compare
subtitle: Compare two websites side-by-side or with overlay modes
description: Visually compare two versions of a website with side-by-side matching, or overlay using opacity (onion), blend, and color blending modes. Perfect for testing design changes, spotting differences, and quality assurance.

features.title: Side-by-Side Comparison
features.description: View two websites next to each other with synchronized scrolling

features.title: Multiple Overlay Modes
features.description: Choose from overlay, blend, or onion modes for different comparison styles

features.title: Custom Viewport Sizes
features.description: Test on mobile (375px), tablet (768px), desktop (1200px), or custom widths

features.title: Synchronized Scrolling
features.description: Both pages scroll together automatically in side-by-side mode

features.title: Dark Mode
features.description: Toggle between light and dark themes for comfortable viewing

features.title: Shareable URLs
